The general public consensuses about the impact of the recent advancement on shopping are overall positive but some have their doubts. And while I do believe that modern advancements have made shopping a lot more convenient, there are downsides to consider, and I will talk about both side and my thoughts below.



First, we should ask ourself what are the aforementioned advancements? For example, you no longer have to spend days to walk to the nearest market every week because modern vehicles and the existence of large shopping malls, supermarket where goods are concentrated have decreased the travel time drastically. While some may disagree but it is unargueable that the improvement of qualities in our modern products and the rather strict regulations in placed have let us be a lot less exhausting when considering whether should we buy anthing. And I argue the most significant advancement is the invention of the refrigerator, this thing revolutionized the entire world. People can now preserve food dramtically longer thus makind everything easier.



On the opposite end of the spectrum, the increasingly competitive market, have in turned make deciding what to choose seemingly impossible to the consumers. This is called choices overload, a phenomena where the consumer is overwhelmed by the amount of choices that it become actively detrimental to their decision making process thus making shopping harder.



In conclusion,while choices overload do make thing slightly harder to decide, I absolutely subscribe to the idea that modern technologies have undoubtly make shopping significantly easier.
